title: Spread by seniority through time, and the second-to-first lien differential

coverage.note: Quarterly FV-weighted median spread per seniority. A cell is dropped, not interpolated, when fewer than 5 positions carry a spread or under 40% of the cell's fair value does; that drops the subordinated series in 4 of 30 observed quarters. 2019Q3, 2022Q1 are absent from the panel and are drawn as shaded breaks on a calendar-continuous axis; no value is interpolated across them.
coverage.sentence: Computed on 19,009 of 31,067 investment-panel rows (61.2% of the window panel). Quarterly FV-weighted median spread per seniority. A cell is dropped, not interpolated, when fewer than 5 positions carry a spread or under 40% of the cell's fair value does; that drops the subordinated series in 4 of 30 observed quarters. 2019Q3, 2022Q1 are absent from the panel and are drawn as shaded breaks on a calendar-continuous axis; no value is interpolated across them.

source: Source: author's calculations on the ARCC BDC panel built from SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q filings.

values.denominator_note: each quarterly median is weighted by the fair value of that seniority's spread-bearing positions in that quarter
